title: HVST-cl-2: opal-research-pull-enqueue redeployed by Terraform so a slash ticker's status object is written under the canonical prefix (source md5 45c83ddf74640e90368e8bebf712b52c); window from GO 15:10Z; rollback = previous artifact version, sha256 equal to CodeSha256 cWiraC3EeuTU9WDIpc5RXzpw6+RT9WxoeqfH/eZiaxo=
author: 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~SC1

legs.target: before-state of the function, artifact, queue and probe key (read only)
legs.proof_required: cl2_before.out holds the function config, the artifact version and sha256, the queue count, the absent probe key, the rollback copy equal to CodeSha256, and the scheduled-task read with its control
cl2_upload.out: one entry lambda_function.py equal to the source md5 45c83ddf, new VersionId read back with content-sha256

legs.target: after-state reads and the refusal probe
legs.proof_required: cl2_after.out and cl2_probe.out: CodeSha256 equals the new zip, env keys/runtime/handler equal, deployed code equals source, probe 400 with queue count and probe key unchanged

legs.target: the one real invoke for BP/ LN Equity through the queue
legs.proof_required: cl2_slash_write.out: 202 with status.json under BP-SLASH-_LN_Equity and nothing under BP/_LN_Equity, or REFUSED_BY_QUEUE recorded plainly

legs.target: cl2_served.out, proof instance VALID, close committed
legs.proof_required: cl2_served.out ends with the five lines; proof checker last line VALID
TF apply (0 destroy) + 0-diff replan + deployed source_code_hash matches uploaded sha + verify-on-served
